result:
I have sufficient evidence to diagnose the issue. The deployment was modified to add a PersistentVolumeClaim volume that references a non-existent StorageClass.

```
ROOT CAUSE: Deployment references PVC demo-app-data which uses non-existent StorageClass "fast-ssd-missing", causing new pods to remain in Pending state due to unbound PVC.

EVIDENCE:
  - kubectl get pods -n rca-test -o wide -> pod/demo-app-6545994d7b-vxmfq is Pending with no node assignment
  - kubectl get events -n rca-test --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -40 -> "Warning ProvisioningFailed persistentvolumeclaim/demo-app-data storageclass.storage.k8s.io 'fast-ssd-missing' not found"
  - kubectl describe pod -n rca-test demo-app-6545994d7b-vxmfq -> "FailedScheduling: 0/2 nodes are available: pod has unbound immediate PersistentVolumeClaims"
  - kubectl get pvc -n rca-test -> demo-app-data is Pending with storageClassName "fast-ssd-missing"
  - kubectl get deploy -n rca-test demo-app -o yaml -> spec.template.spec.volumes includes PVC demo-app-data (not in original last-applied-configuration)

CONFIDENCE: high

PROPOSED PATCH:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: demo-app
  namespace: rca-test
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: app
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /opt/app
          name: code
        - mountPath: /etc/demo/config
          name: config
          readOnly: true
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: "200m"
            memory: "128Mi"
          requests:
            cpu: "20m"
            memory: "48Mi"
      volumes:
      - configMap:
          name: demo-app-code
        name: code
      - configMap:
          items:
          - key: LOG_LEVEL
            path: LOG_LEVEL
          name: demo-app-config
        name: config
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: demo-app-data
  namespace: rca-test
$patch: delete
```
